# Delivery Architect Component Spec Materialization Proof Packet

## Objective

Refactor a governed component authority doc into a template-conformant, materialization-ready bridge artifact and prove that its structured tables reconcile downstream model truth correctly.

## Authority Docs

- `/Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/docs/2_Design/2026-05-20-component-spec-template-materialization-bridge.md`
- `/Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/docs/2_Design/2026-05-20-component-spec-section-to-model-mapping-table.md`
- `/Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/docs/2_Design/2026-05-20-component-spec-doc-to-materialization-extraction-rules.md`
- `/Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/docs/2_Design/2026-05-19-governed-code-backed-component-materialization-policy.md`

## Input Artifact

One governed design authority doc, usually one of:
- `component-spec`
- repository `contract` doc that is being used as component authority

## Required Work

1. identify template-conformance gaps in the target doc
2. preserve valid narrative authority
3. add required materialization-driving sections and tables
4. validate governed-doc cleanliness
5. run the doc extractor
6. run the narrow materializer
7. validate model/code consistency
8. validate spec/model count consistency

## Required Structured Sections

- `Component Identity Table`
- `Ownership Boundary`
- `Non-Ownership Boundary`
- `Collaborators`
- `Component Elements Table`
- `Realizations Table`
- `Plan Seed Table`
- `Activity Seed Table`
- `Activity Dependency Table`
- `Verification Surface Table`
- `Constraints And Non-Goals`

## Required Deliverables

- updated governed authority doc
- conformance delta note if needed
- extractor-compatible structured tables
- narrow materializer script or reconciler path
- validation results showing model truth alignment

## Standard Validation Commands

```bash
bash /Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/scripts/docs/lint_governed_docs.sh
cd /Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform && basedpyright --project pyrightconfig.json packages/paa-core/src/paa_core/governance
cd /Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform && PYTHONPATH=packages/paa-core/src python scripts/governance/paa_model_code_consistency.py --component <ComponentName>
cd /Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform && PYTHONPATH=packages/paa-core/src python scripts/governance/paa_component_spec_model_consistency.py --spec <SpecPath>
```

## Current Proven Pattern

The pattern is already proven for:
- `WorkflowLifecycleService`
- `ExecutionPackageResolutionService`
- `ImplementationPlanRepository` model-code-runtime proof chain, with doc-driven materialization now becoming the next repository-surface proof

## Packet Exit Criteria

The packet is complete when:
- the governed doc is template-conformant
- the doc extractor reads it fail-closed
- the materializer reconciles the component slice from the doc tables
- the spec/model count checker returns no blocking gaps
